mainEntity.name: What should I look for in a contractor for a primary bathroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for a primary bathroom addition, look for experience in similar projects, proper licensing and insurance, and strong references. A contractor who communicates clearly and provides a transparent, detailed proposal is crucial. As a construction company serving the Bay Area, Hometelligent Inc. prioritizes these aspects, ensuring our clients feel confident in our ability to deliver quality workmanship and manage the project effectively from start to finish.
